question: In May 2025, the central government extended the tenure of Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) director Praveen Sood for a period of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The central government extended the tenure of Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) director **Praveen Sood** for a period of 1 year in May 2025.
 
• The extension of tenure is allowed under the provisions of the **DSPE Act, 1946**, which governs the functioning of the CBI.
 
• Such extensions are granted on the grounds of ensuring continuity and efficiency in the leadership of the organization.
 
• Praveen Sood, an IPS officer of the Karnataka cadre, was appointed as the CBI Director in May 2023 for an initial two-year tenure.
 
• This decision underscores the government’s focus on ensuring stability in the functioning of India’s premier investigative agency, particularly in high-profile cases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI):**

 
 
• The CBI is India’s premier investigative agency, functioning under the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions.
 
• It investigates cases of corruption, economic offenses, and serious crimes, including cross-state and international cases.
 
• The CBI derives its power from the **Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Leadership Continuity:**
 
 
• Leadership continuity in organizations like the CBI ensures efficient handling of ongoing investigations and sensitive cases.
 
• It also helps maintain institutional integrity and public trust in the agency’s operations.
